title: Contact barrier against villa's tracer on held-out PHerc0139 windings
subtitle: Same seeds, same box, two repeats; one sector, z 5248 to 5760, 9.362 um scan; frozen rule, 22 Oct 2026. Model output.
source_note: Numbers copied from the test's readout.json (sha256 above), kept in the private repository with the preregistration it was frozen under.
desc: Two bar charts over five seeded PHerc0139 windings (w049, w051, w055, w057, w058). Left: area each arm covered on its own winding, about 0.1 to 0.43 cm2 for every arm; the contact barrier arm passed both gates on w051 and w055 in both repeats. Right: area put on other windings, where lower is better: villa's tracer 0.08 to 5.43 cm2 per winding, the AutoPipeline trace without the barrier 0.04 to 7.87 cm2, with the barrier 0.00 to 0.03 cm2.
alt: Two grouped bar charts. Left, area on the seeded winding: all three arms cover similar area, 0.1 to 0.43 cm2 per winding; the contact barrier arm is marked pass on w051 and w055. Right, area on other windings (lower is better): orange and green bars reach up to 5.4 and 7.9 cm2, the blue contact barrier bars stay at 0.00 to 0.03 cm2.
caption: Held-out comparison on PHerc0139 (report windings w049 to w058, z 5248 to 5760), frozen rule, two repeats, 22 October 2026. The contact barrier arm passed 2 of 5 windings in both repeats and villa's stock tracer 0 of 5. Model output: traced geometry scored against the published windings, no ink.
claim_label: Model output: gated surface scores of traces on PHerc0139 against its published windings; one sector, five windings, two repeats
credit: Scores from a frozen held-out test run on 22 October 2026; the windings are the published PHerc0139 meshes of the Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0 (no scan pixels in the chart)
foot: Barrier rule digest 3165f76a (the same in AutoPipeline 0.1.9). villa at e0bbb8b in the same harness, no seed anchor, no repair.
